page_title: MAR 1-3 AUX | Marseille v Auxerre 08/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Marseille quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+4' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
90+3' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul after Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) hacks down one of his opponents. Marseille earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
90+1' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) is caught offside!
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
88' Theo Bair (Auxerre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marc Bollengier had an easy-decision to make.
87' Marc Bollengier shows a yellow card to Elye Wahi (Marseille) for his blatant foul.
86' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle after Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gaetan Perrin departs the field of play to be replaced by Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre).
84' Auxerre concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. There is a free kick near the sideline to Marseille.
83' Ismael Kone (Marseille) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
80' Theo Bair (Auxerre) commits a foul and Marc Bollengier immediately signals a free kick.
79' We are about to witness a subsitution. Theo Bair (Auxerre) for Kevin Danois.
78' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Assane Diousse replaces him.
78' It doesn’t look good for Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
77' The manager makes a subsitution with Michael Murillo (Marseille) coming on for Pol Lirola.
77' Excellent touch by Mason Greenwood (Marseille)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
76' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Geronimo Rulli.
74' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
73' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) tackles a bit over-zealously and Marc Bollengier blows for a foul.
72' The linesman signals that Luis Henrique (Marseille) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
71' Elye Wahi (Marseille) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
66' It is time for a substitution. Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) is on for Lilian Brassier.
66' Donovan Leon (Auxerre) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
66' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
65' 1 - 3 Mason Greenwood (Marseille) smoothly converts the penalty with a beautiful low drive into the left side of the net.
65' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
64' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Clement Akpa (Auxerre) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A penalty is awarded to Marseille!
61' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

61' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Auxerre.
60' Booking. Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) receives a caution from the referee.
59' Elye Wahi (Marseille) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
57' Auxerre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

57' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Auxerre.
56' The corner is swung in but Marseille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
55' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag and Marseille will take a corner.
54' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Luis Henrique (Marseille) blazes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.

53' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Marc Bollengier blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.

49' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) attempts to test the goalkeeper after collecting a cross inside the penalty area. Luck doesn't appear to be on his side today as his attempt rattles the left post. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
48' Ismael Kone (Marseille) jumps into a tackle and Marc Bollengier signals a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Roberto De Zerbi decided to make a change. Quentin Merlin (Marseille) is replaced by Ulisses Garcia.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) comes off for Ismael Kone.
46' The game is over for Neal Maupay (Marseille). Elye Wahi comes on for the second half.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Marc Bollengier blows the whistle, Kevin Danois (Auxerre) is penalised for a foul. Marseille have a free kick.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' 0 - 3 Goal! Gaetan Perrin plays a pass to the feet of Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre), and he shoots into the bottom right corner from inside the box. It's 0:3.

43' 0 - 2 Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) runs on to a clever pass from Lassine Sinayoko and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He still has work to do but finishes with aplomb into the back of the net.
41' Marseille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
41' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Marseille will take a corner kick.
39' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
38' The referee blows his whistle after Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
37' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle. Gabriel Osho (Auxerre) commits a foul after dangerous play. It's a free kick to Marseille in a dangerous position.

35' Neal Maupay (Marseille) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Donovan Leon pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going low into the middle of the target.
35' A player from Marseille takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
31' The ball is crossed into the box and Neal Maupay (Marseille) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the bottom right corner, but Donovan Leon gets a glove on it to thwart him.

31' What a poor attempt! Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
29' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
28' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
25' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.

24' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) watches the cross in from Mason Greenwood, but plants his header from the edge of the six-yard box well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
21' Pol Lirola (Marseille) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
20' Marseille take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

20' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Marseille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
19' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle after Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Marseille get a free kick.
18' Luis Henrique (Marseille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

15' Lilian Brassier (Marseille) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
15' Corner kick. Marseille will have an opportunity.

14' The ball is cleared after Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes behind for a corner. Marseille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

10' 0 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 0:1.
9' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle and it's Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
7' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
6' Pol Lirola (Marseille) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
4' Gabriel Osho (Auxerre) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Geronimo Rulli is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
4' Marc Bollengier has a clear sight and sees a foul from Pol Lirola (Marseille).
3' A corner kick by Auxerre is thwarted by the well prepared Geronimo Rulli (Marseille).
3' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Auxerre can continue in their attacking effort.
2' Pol Lirola (Marseille) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) offside.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Auxerre will have the kick-off.
Marc Bollengier got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
